_variante.propos: un appel d'image seule : le sprite promu en 256 px (taille retenue par E2), les lignes de bible du témoin et une seule ligne de demande — le personnage de profil, en pose de contact
_variante.texte:
World: a quiet medieval fantasy world of long roads, forests and cold nights
Era: early middle ages, mail and spears, before gunpowder
Rendering technique: 2D pixel art on a 64x64 grid
Line and shading: solid black outline, one pixel wide
View and framing: side view, orthographic, full-body character centered
Technical constraints: single isolated sprite on a flat background, strict 64x64 px tile snap

The same character, seen from the side as in the game's camera, standing in the contact pose of a walk cycle (front foot forward and planted, back foot behind, arms opposite to legs), full body, single isolated sprite, plain background.
